roi_h1c_function_trajectory.summary:
Caveats
  • Every value is synthetic (tests/fixtures/mri_h1c/make_spec.py); only the structure is the H1c export's.
  • Only the group difference in change over p60→p120 is the registered test; the other contrasts are descriptive.
  • Cohen's d carries no interval in this export, so the summary reports the contrast estimate with its bootstrap interval.
Role
confirmatory
Design
n = 34 (cuprizone 24, control 10)
Inference
per test, a linear model with the cuprizone cohort modelled (size-weighted); t test of the contrast
Correction
p per test from the cohort model's t, uncorrected across tests, measures and ROIs
Corrected over
none: each test on its own; the ROI rows are post hoc
Effect
contrast estimate — the contrast in the measure's own units (mean change, or cuprizone minus control) with a 95% bootstrap interval; Cohen's d (pooled SD, ignoring cohort) is beside it, without an interval

96 tests (one measure's grey-matter-wide summary in one contrast); 32 reach uncorrected p < 0.05. Every test is listed, significant or not.
